card_dimensions.note: Positions are in logical pixels (300x450). Actual rendered size is 600x900 @ 2x scale.

atk.note: First combat stat box (ATK). Position is for value text within .combat-value element.

hp.note: Second combat stat box (HP). Position is for value text within .combat-value element.

usage_notes.structure: Positions assume card is rendered at 300x450. Actual PNG is 600x900 (2x scale factor).
usage_notes.coordinate_system: Top-left origin (0,0). X increases rightward, Y increases downward.
usage_notes.react_integration: Use these positions to absolutely-position text overlays on top of the card image.
usage_notes.scaling: If displaying card at different size, scale coordinates proportionally. E.g., if displayed at 150x225 (0.5x), multiply all coordinates by 0.5.
usage_notes.value_positioning: Combat stats positions assume text should be centered within the .combat-value element. Use text-align: center and vertical alignment.
